title: China seeks better PH ties amid war of words over envoy’s remarks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Amid a war of words between the Chinese ambassador and several Philippine officials, China has expressed willingness to improve its relationship with the Philippines and manage differences through dialogue. The Chinese embassy in Manila on Sunday released the response of Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning during a news conference on Oct. 16, when she was asked to comment on Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan’s statement that China could “easily win” in a military conflict between the two countries but would not use force to settle disputes.
